verdict.rationale: Superset orchestrates third-party CLI agents in isolated worktrees, so a repo-level conventions or context file is a fair axis for it. The pack never documents a way for developers to add one that agents consume. The nearest items are setup/teardown scripts for dependencies and environment, first-party skills (computer, orchestrate), and Superset's own agents.md, and none of these is a user-authored conventions file.
